subject: planner: move iterate physical plan out (#50628)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff for `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go`: it refactors the in-function `iteration` closure inside `(*baseLogicalPlan).enumeratePhysicalPlans4Task` into a new method `(*baseLogicalPlan).iteratePhysicalPlan`, with identical child-task selection logic (same `GetChildReqProps`, `findBestTask(..., &PlanCounterDisabled, ...)`, invalid-task short-circuit, and plan-count multiplication). Verified the `LogicalSequence` special path still overrides iteration via `seq.iterateChildPlan` with the same function signature. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` for follow-up fixes touching this area; no evidence of a bug introduced by this change.
